bullets.text: Revolut Targets Indian Market - **Revolut** aims to disrupt Indian banks with lower forex fees and innovative payment solutions.
Apple's iOS 26.1 Beta - The latest **iOS** beta introduces automatic security updates for enhanced device protection.
October Prime Day Deals - Amazon's October Prime Day features significant discounts on tech, including **Apple** products.
Tesla's New Affordable Models - **Tesla** unveils budget-friendly versions of the Model 3 and Model Y to boost sales.
X Introduces Premium Tiers - **X** rebrands its Verified Organizations into Premium Business and Premium Organizations for better user engagement.
